pages.text: One bearing gives a direction; two bearings from different places cross where the transmitter is. Press 2 (or TAB) for the $(thing)FIX$() page.$(br2)Press A and type another station's X, Z, its bearing and its accuracy (enter alone means 5 degrees). Up to six can be typed in; D deletes the one selected.

pages.title: A good fix
pages.text: The fix shows its X and Z, how many blocks it is good to, and its range and bearing from you. It needs:$(li)two bearings or more$(li)two stations at least $(thing)48 blocks$() apart$(li)bearings crossing at 15 degrees or more$(br)Otherwise the page says why it cannot fix. Bearings at a wide angle give the smallest box.

pages.title: Over a link
pages.text: A direction finder touching a $(l:radiocraft:microwave/microwave_radio)microwave radio$(/l) gets the bearings of direction finders at the other end of its link tuned to the same frequency, and adds them to the fix by itself (the L rows).
